engineering_indicator_coverage.method_note: 覆盖率统计原始数据和证据是否存在，不代表指标已经被赋权。指标只有通过已批准的频率修正模型才能改变失效频率。

formal_release_blockers: 失效频率修正模型或其系数未标记为APPROVED_CALIBRATED/APPROVED_PROJECT_FACTORS

frequency_correction_model.method_note: SY/T 6891.2附录A定义K_j(a1,a2,...)但不提供统一权重。log_linear_calibrated只是受支持的校准函数形式，系数必须由适用失效数据拟合并批准。
frequency_correction_model.source: SY/T 6891.2-2020 Annex A formula A.1; synthetic uncalibrated K_j values

assumptions_and_limitations: complete rupture uses the initial two-sided adiabatic choked-flow solution and does not yet solve transient line-pack depletion
dispersion uses the AQ/T 3046 Pasquill-Gifford continuous plume; high-pressure near-field transition requires independent validation
horizontal jet fire uses the conservative radial worst-case orientation envelope
TNO explosion-source volume and source strength are explicit project inputs
Figure E.1 curve points are digitized and remain provisional until independently benchmarked

mixing_rules.heat_capacity: ideal-gas mole-fraction weighted Cp at approximately 288-298 K
mixing_rules.lfl: Le Chatelier rule over combustible components
mixing_rules.lower_heating_value: mole-fraction weighted molar LHV divided by mixture molar mass

criterion.applicability_note: 用于油气管道隐患位置个人风险ALARP判断；图中数值标注为参考值。项目合同、属地法规或主管部门另有批准准则时，应由版本化准则集替换。

individual_risk.note: IR采用100%室外个体死亡概率且不乘人口；社会风险按每个时段的室内外人口比例计算。
